description: Source code for Lua's internal state management, including thread and global state initialization, stack management, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: LG
classes.description: Main thread structure combining lua_State and global_State.

methods.name: stack_init
methods.description: Initializes the call info array and stack for a new Lua thread.

methods.name: freestack
methods.description: Frees the call info array and stack of a Lua thread.

methods.name: f_luaopen
methods.description: Initializes parts of the Lua state that may cause memory allocation errors.

methods.name: preinit_state
methods.description: Prepares a Lua state with default values before full initialization.

methods.name: close_state
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a Lua state.

methods.name: lua_newstate
methods.description: Creates a new Lua state with custom allocator.

methods.name: lua_close
methods.description: Closes and frees a Lua state.
